conventions.fit: y = k*x; zero intercept; grouped median log ratios then mean across groups
conventions.interval: Factor CI95 is not held-out P95 or individual prediction uncertainty
conventions.evidence: Metric identity, value evidence class and model role are separate
conventions.dependency: depends_on records calculation dependencies; dataset_ids and shared_evidence describe evidence reuse
conventions.coefficients: Numerical coefficients remain in referenced outputs, not duplicated in this registry
conventions.primary_error: 100*abs(predicted/observed-1); linear P95 over equal model/configuration centers; canonical field model_center_p95_percent
conventions.observation_error: Secondary only: equal model weights, then equal observations within model; explicitly named weighted CDF P95
conventions.execution_admission: Mode-specific exclusion of confirmed same-track constant-count conflicts; unknown/nonuniform counts remain provisional; no score scaling.

models.title: Direct classical → speed-VAXen
models.formula: log y = b*(log x - log x_780); the VAX-11/780 scores 1
models.shared_evidence: Single-score baselines share identical tuples and folds; source stages reuse observations

models.title: Classical → SPECint89 → speed-VAXen
models.formula: log(SPECint89 * bridge) = b*(log x - log x_780); implemented as 89_only cohort

models.title: Classical observed/inferred-target joint fit
models.formula: log y = b*(log x - log x_780); SPECint89 targets times the bridge
models.shared_evidence: Shared model keys resampled jointly across the bridge and training; estimated-target errors separate from observed-SPECint92 holdouts

models.title: Historical workload reconstruction
models.formula: documented timing reconstruction plus future validated calibration; no implemented VAXen edge

models.title: Sparse individual-benchmark network calibration
models.formula: family/node/model-balanced log WLS with eliminated latent unanchored targets; ln y = a_b + beta_g*ln x_b, one exponent per group (Dhrystone versions shared, each Whetstone precision alone, LINPACK), a_b = -beta_g*ln(VAX-11/780 median score); exponents from anchored and multi-family nodes, then free intercepts from all nodes
models.shared_evidence: Shared source IDs grouped under accepted alias closure; bridges and coefficients share model bootstrap weights; unknown targets not measured SPECint92

models.title: Single-metric power-law sensitivity (diagnostic)
models.formula: log y = a + b*log x (+ c*(year-1990)); proportional, free OLS/Deming, VAX-11/780-anchored
models.shared_evidence: Reuses the network's anchored nodes; never chained into an estimate

models.title: Conditional Gibson/ADP joint classical-speed calibration
models.formula: Classical family power-law network through the VAX-11/780; InstructionMix variants share a family and exponent with free intercepts
variants: CCTA/TSU only; peak; resolved_system/plus_pending_links; reported_clock/linear_clock; spec92_only/with_spec89
models.shared_evidence: Ratings attach by resolved system; nodes sharing a rating form one bootstrap/holdout cluster; proxy holdouts are not SPEC errors
